notes.title: The Zueirama 2077 is available now!
Zueirama 2077
Launch of Zueirama 2077
notes.content:
Sorry for the delay, these last few years have not been easy, a lot has changed, we had to look for new jobs and now at Zueirama's two-year anniversary celebration, we're finally going to release the big update on August 6th.

The update contains; A new map with new stages, story, enemies and a boss. In addition to fixing several bugs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33705628/a400b2c502153decf3a18209a76a827dfdfb48bf.png[/img]

notes.title: Zueirama 2077
notes.content:
The year is 2077, my city has become the craziest place in the world.
Main issues?
Memes, trolls and jurry-rig everywhere.

The city is full of opportunities for Trolling, and I am BIG Troll.

Discover the power of the zueira.
